usageNotes: Returns the ACME configuration directory index for Proxmox Datacenter Manager, listing available ACME sub-resources (accounts, plugins, etc.). Use this as a discovery call before working with ACME certificate automation. Requires no special privileges — any authenticated user or API token can call it.
tips: This is a directory index endpoint — it lists sub-resource paths, not ACME account or plugin data itself. Follow up with more specific ACME endpoints to read or manage accounts and plugins.
The returns type is 'null' in the spec, meaning the response structure is not formally typed; treat the response as an informational directory listing.
